caption: Descriptive frozen-forecast cases at 30, 120 and 300 minute leads, aligned by target time. Black denotes the model-corrected target, not untouched meter output. Days are selected nearest the 10th/90th percentile of mean absolute consecutive five-minute target ramp divided by daily target P95, using common daylight timestamps across all three leads, at least 72 targets, 60 adjacent pairs and target P95 >= 2 kW. Selection uses targets only, not prediction errors. Missing intervals break curves. These post-study examples are illustrative, not confirmatory or representative of every fold.
